description: ~/.config/icon-sets-sync/config.json: settings for every run on this machine. Generated from the settings registry; do not edit.

$schema.description: Editor hint. Ignored by the loader.

allowed_hosts.description: extra upstream hosts, comma separated, on top of the built-in github.com, api.github.com, codeload.github.com, registry.npmjs.org and unicode.org (https only) (environment: ICHAVA_ALLOWED_HOSTS)

concurrency.description: packs synced at once by sync --all / sync-all (environment: ICHAVA_CONCURRENCY)

config_dir.description: directory holding packs.json and the pack configs (default: config/ beside the binary, else ./config when it holds packs.json, else the config/ of the repository around the working directory, up to 5 levels) (environment: ICHAVA_CONFIG_DIR)

dry_run.description: fetch and diff, but write nothing into the pack and skip the version stamp, commit, push and pull request (environment: ICHAVA_DRY_RUN)

unicode_version.description: Unicode emoji release whose emoji-test.txt drives categorisation; must exist at unicode.org/Public/emoji/ (environment: ICHAVA_EMOJI_UNICODE_VERSION)

force.description: refresh even when the pack is not behind upstream (environment: ICHAVA_FORCE)

author.description: author and committer of sync commits, as `Name <email>` (environment: ICHAVA_GIT_AUTHOR)

base.description: base branch the pull request targets (environment: ICHAVA_GIT_BASE)

branch.description: sync branch; {version} is the upstream version (environment: ICHAVA_GIT_BRANCH)

commit_body.default:
Automated sync from upstream {pack} {old} -> {new}.

Generated by ichava/icon-sets-sync. See docs/maintainer-sync.md in that repository.
commit_body.description: commit and PR body; same tokens as the subject (environment: ICHAVA_GIT_COMMIT_BODY)

commit_subject.description: commit and PR title; {pack}, {old}, {new} are interpolated (environment: ICHAVA_GIT_COMMIT_SUBJECT)

open_pr.description: open a pull request after pushing (environment: ICHAVA_GIT_OPEN_PR)

history_keep.description: copies of each config file kept in ~/.local/state/icon-sets-sync/history/ before a save from the web UI or config edit, fix or restore; 0 keeps none (environment: ICHAVA_HISTORY_KEEP)

log_level.description: log verbosity; -v is debug, -q is error (environment: ICHAVA_LOG_LEVEL)

npm_path.description: the npm executable, for the npm pack fallback when the registry fetch fails (default: PATH, then Homebrew, Volta, fnm, asdf and nvm's directories; npm's own on Windows) (environment: ICHAVA_NPM_PATH)

packages_dir.description: Alias of packages_dirs; `config fix` renames it.

packages_dirs.description: directories holding the ichava pack checkouts, searched in order for <pack>/ (a string or a list; ~ and paths relative to the config file are resolved; ICHAVA_PACKAGES_DIRS uses the OS list separator; --packages-dir repeats). Searched before workspace (environment: ICHAVA_PACKAGES_DIRS)

private_config_dir.description: directory of private pack configs merged over config_dir at run time (packs.json optional; none by default) (environment: ICHAVA_PRIVATE_CONFIG_DIR)

workspace.description: directory holding the pack checkouts: a relative pack_root is resolved against it, and it replaces the /work/<pack> a shipped config names (default: /work if present, else the checkouts beside this repository) (environment: ICHAVA_WORKSPACE)

title: icon-sets-sync global config
